visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-angle drone shot establishes a vast green park with manicured grass and a winding grey path. A male character in a white shirt and beige shorts walks along the path carrying a large, off-white rectangular bag. City skyscrapers are visible in the far background under a bright, clear sky. (2) Medium tracking shots show the man's face clearly; he wears glasses and a beige cap, smiling broadly and moving his lips as if singing. His hands grip the straps of the bulky bag. The lighting is strong natural daylight, highlighting the texture of his clothes and the grass. (3) The man transitions from the path to the green lawn. He sets the large rectangular bag down and proceeds to unfold it, revealing a thick, foldable mattress. He works with his hands to flatten the sections. A brown ground cloth is also spread out on the grass. (4) Close-up shots focus on his hands as he meticulously prepares the sleeping area. He lies down on the mattress, spreading his arms wide. His facial expression reflects deep satisfaction and comfort. The camera moves to a direct top-down overhead perspective. (5) The final sequence features the man lying motionless and relaxed on the mattress amidst the green field. The camera pans and zooms out significantly, making the man appear smaller. Large white text overlays and brand logos appear on the screen, while the green landscape fills the frame.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional lifestyle advertisement for the 'Sleepy Tofu' brand's outdoor mattress. It utilizes a cheerful, high-quality music video format to convey the feeling of comfort and relaxation one can achieve by using their portable product in a natural setting.
